summary:
Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature by editing files only; no tests or repository code were run, so nothing is verified by execution.

Changes:
- rich/tree.py: added Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative, explicit stack, level counter, indent = 4 * level, max_width passed unchanged). Imports Measurement from rich.measure.
- rich/align.py: added Align.__repr__; Align.__rich_console__ now constrains the wrapped renderable to its measured maximum (or min of that and width). Added public VerticalCenter with __init__, __repr__, __rich_console__ (newline-segment padding using console.size.height), and __rich_measure__.
- rich/console.py: print passes justify="default" in render options; collection still receives justify.
- CHANGELOG.md: 9.8.0 marked Unreleased, with an Added subsection holding the two entries.
- tests/test_align.py: imports VerticalCenter; adds repr, render (height 6 -> "\n\nfoo\n\n\n"), and measurement (Measurement(3, 3)) tests.
- tests/test_tree.py: imports Measurement; adds test_measure expecting Measurement(11, 19) for the example tree.

Not committed. Test results are unknown because I did not run them.
